+		{SUSEEnterpriseServer, "13", time.Date(2026, 4, 30, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC), false},
+		{SUSEEnterpriseServer, "14", time.Date(2028, 11, 30, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC), false},
+		{MacOS, "11", time.Time{}, true},
+		{MacOS, "15", time.Time{}, false},
